question: An elevator starts from rest and its speed increases uniformly to $4$ m/s in $3$ s. It moves at this speed until $t = 9$ s and then slows down uniformly to stop at $t = 12$ s. The height through which it rises is
solution:
Height = area under the $v$-$t$ graph (a trapezium):
$$\frac{1}{2}(3)(4) + (9 - 3)(4) + \frac{1}{2}(3)(4) = 6 + 24 + 6 = 36\ \text{m}$$
